name: Starweaver Comet Thread
description: A radiant thread pulled from a cooling comet wake.
specialEffects: Used in astral blades, stellar bindings, and comet-tempered craftwork.

steps: Refine raw stock for Starweaver Comet Thread under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Starweaver Refinery protocol before storage.
